title: Your Way / Logo Lockup Clearspace
slide_intent: Distinguish the gap within a lockup from clearance around it so the elements read as one signature without crowding other content.
strategic_value: Separate repeatable measurements can keep Burger King’s closing signature balanced at different sizes.
demonstration: A shaded diagram surrounds the logo-and-Your Way lockup, using W-height for external clearance and Burger G-width between the elements.
practical_value: Use W-height around the combination and G-width inside it, measuring vertical clearance from the logo edges.

content_islands.name: Measurement explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the external and internal spacing definitions and edge note at left.

content_islands.name: Lockup construction
content_islands.spec: Show the pale lockup inside a shaded diagram at right, with W units around the perimeter and G between logo and phrase.

reference_purposes.Application: The page defines external clearspace by Your Way W-height and the internal gap by Burger G-width.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Top and bottom clearspace are measured from the edges of the logo element.

ingredient.name: Your Way lockup spacing
ingredient.role: Keep the promise and logo connected while separating the complete signature from other content.
ingredient.application: Reserve W-height around the lockup and G-width between logo and phrase; measure vertical clearance from the logo edges.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; applies to the supplied Your Way logo lockup.
